text: The valet ticket says: parked at owner's risk.
The Supreme Court ruled in twenty nineteen:
once a hotel's valet takes your keys, the car is in its care,
even if the valet service is free.
Lost or damaged? The hotel must prove it took proper care.
An owner's risk line can't excuse its own negligence.
Parked it yourself? Then this rule doesn't apply.
Keep the ticket. Report any damage right away, in writing.
